istem:
Research question: Grafik ve çizelge anlama için çok kipli büyük dil modelleri üzerine en önemli çalışmalar, sınırlılıklar ve açık problemler neler?

Cutoff date: 2026-01-08. Only works published BEFORE this date count.

List the 30 most important works (papers) for this research question that were published before the cutoff date, in order of importance (most important first) — the kind a careful expert survey published right after the cutoff would cite. Give each with its arXiv id and/or DOI.

You MUST research this with web search rather than answer from memory: search for the important works, and verify each listed work's title, publication date and identifier on the web (e.g. arxiv.org, doi.org, the publisher or DBLP page) before including it.

When you are done, reply with ONLY a JSON object in this form (no other text):
{"calismalar": [{"sira": 1, "baslik": "exact title", "yil": 2020, "arxiv_id": "arXiv id or null", "doi": "DOI or null", "gerekce": "one sentence on why this work is important"}]}
with exactly 30 items. If you do not know an identifier, use null instead of guessing.

calismalar.baslik: ChartQA: A Benchmark for Question Answering about Charts with Visual and Logical Reasoning
calismalar.gerekce: The standard benchmark for chart QA, with human-written visual and logical reasoning questions; nearly every chart MLLM reports results on it.

calismalar.baslik: CharXiv: Charting Gaps in Realistic Chart Understanding in Multimodal LLMs
calismalar.gerekce: Uses realistic charts from arXiv papers to show that older benchmarks overestimate MLLM progress, and documents a large gap between models and humans.

calismalar.baslik: MatCha: Enhancing Visual Language Pretraining with Math Reasoning and Chart Derendering
calismalar.gerekce: Introduced chart de-rendering and math-reasoning pretraining, a basis for later chart models.

calismalar.baslik: DePlot: One-shot visual language reasoning by plot-to-table translation
calismalar.gerekce: Established the two-stage approach of turning a chart into a table and then reasoning over it with an LLM.

calismalar.baslik: From Pixels to Insights: A Survey on Automatic Chart Understanding in the Era of Large Foundation Models
calismalar.gerekce: Main survey of chart understanding in the foundation-model era, covering tasks, metrics, models and open problems.

calismalar.baslik: UniChart: A Universal Vision-language Pretrained Model for Chart Comprehension and Reasoning
calismalar.gerekce: A universal chart model pretrained on low- and high-level chart tasks over a large chart corpus.

calismalar.baslik: ChartLlama: A Multimodal LLM for Chart Understanding and Generation
calismalar.gerekce: An early example of chart instruction tuning with synthetic data generated by GPT-4.

calismalar.baslik: MMC: Advancing Multimodal Chart Understanding with Large-scale Instruction Tuning
calismalar.gerekce: Offers a 600k-instance chart instruction set and a human-annotated benchmark, and shows that GPT-4V also struggles with charts.

calismalar.baslik: ChartGemma: Visual Instruction-tuning for Chart Reasoning in the Wild
calismalar.gerekce: Generates instruction data directly from chart images rather than data tables, which improves generalization to real-world charts.

calismalar.baslik: ChartQAPro: A More Diverse and Challenging Benchmark for Chart Question Answering
calismalar.gerekce: Shows that ChartQA is saturated: model scores fall from about 90% on ChartQA to about 56% on this harder, more diverse benchmark.

calismalar.baslik: ChartMuseum: Testing Visual Reasoning Capabilities of Large Vision-Language Models
calismalar.gerekce: Shows a large gap between humans (93%) and the best model (63%) on questions that need mainly visual reasoning.

calismalar.baslik: ChartX & ChartVLM: A Versatile Benchmark and Foundation Model for Complicated Chart Reasoning
calismalar.gerekce: A broad benchmark covering 18 chart types and 7 tasks, plus an interpretable cascaded-decoder chart model.

calismalar.baslik: ChartAssisstant: A Universal Chart Multimodal Language Model via Chart-to-Table Pre-training and Multitask Instruction Tuning
calismalar.gerekce: Proposed two-stage training (chart-to-table alignment followed by multitask tuning) and the broad ChartSFT dataset.

calismalar.baslik: ChartInstruct: Instruction Tuning for Chart Comprehension and Reasoning
calismalar.gerekce: A 191K chart instruction set built from real-world charts, with both end-to-end and pipeline systems.

calismalar.baslik: ChartBench: A Benchmark for Complex Visual Reasoning in Charts
calismalar.gerekce: Tests value reading on charts without data-point labels and introduces the Acc+ metric, which is robust to guessing.

calismalar.baslik: Pix2Struct: Screenshot Parsing as Pretraining for Visual Language Understanding
calismalar.gerekce: The pixel-to-text pretraining backbone that MatCha and DePlot build on, and important for visually rich inputs.

calismalar.baslik: PlotQA: Reasoning over Scientific Plots
calismalar.gerekce: A large-scale benchmark requiring real-valued answers outside a fixed vocabulary, built from real data.

calismalar.baslik: Chart-to-Text: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Chart Summarization
calismalar.gerekce: The core benchmark for chart summarization, and an early record of hallucination and factual errors in generated summaries.

calismalar.baslik: TinyChart: Efficient Chart Understanding with Visual Token Merging and Program-of-Thoughts Learning
calismalar.gerekce: Tackles efficiency and numerical reasoning with a 3B model, using visual token merging and program-of-thought learning.

calismalar.baslik: ChartMimic: Evaluating LMM's Cross-Modal Reasoning Capability via Chart-to-Code Generation
calismalar.gerekce: Set up chart-to-code generation as a benchmark of cross-modal reasoning.

calismalar.baslik: ChartMoE: Mixture of Diversely Aligned Expert Connector for Chart Understanding
calismalar.gerekce: Improves chart MLLMs with a mixture-of-experts connector whose experts are aligned on table, JSON and code tasks.

calismalar.baslik: FigureQA: An Annotated Figure Dataset for Visual Reasoning
calismalar.gerekce: One of the first large synthetic datasets for visual reasoning over charts and figures.

calismalar.baslik: DVQA: Understanding Data Visualizations via Question Answering
calismalar.gerekce: An early bar-chart QA dataset showing that classic VQA models fail on chart-specific vocabulary.

calismalar.baslik: Chart-based Reasoning: Transferring Capabilities from LLMs to VLMs
calismalar.gerekce: Distills LLM reasoning into a small VLM using synthetic reasoning traces generated from chart tables (ChartPaLI-5B).

calismalar.baslik: Distill Visual Chart Reasoning Ability from LLMs to MLLMs
calismalar.gerekce: Proposes code-as-intermediary data synthesis and the reasoning-intensive ReachQA dataset.

calismalar.baslik: Scaling Text-Rich Image Understanding via Code-Guided Synthetic Multimodal Data Generation
calismalar.gerekce: Shows that code-guided synthetic data (CoSyn) produces strong open models for charts and other text-rich images.

calismalar.baslik: Effective Training Data Synthesis for Improving MLLM Chart Understanding
calismalar.gerekce: Addresses the realism gap in synthetic chart data with a modular pipeline and the ECD dataset (ICCV 2025).

calismalar.baslik: Chart-R1: Chain-of-Thought Supervision and Reinforcement for Advanced Chart Reasoner
calismalar.gerekce: Represents the trend toward reinforcement fine-tuning for chart reasoning (CoT supervision followed by GRPO).

calismalar.baslik: ChartCoder: Advancing Multimodal Large Language Model for Chart-to-Code Generation
calismalar.gerekce: Advances chart-to-code generation with a code-LLM backbone and the Chart2Code-160k dataset.

calismalar.baslik: MathVista: Evaluating Mathematical Reasoning of Foundation Models in Visual Contexts
calismalar.gerekce: A widely used benchmark for mathematical reasoning over charts and figures, and a standard reference for measuring the reasoning limits of MLLMs.
